criteria.title: Symptoms documented for required duration
criteria.description: Symptoms must continue beyond the policy-defined period.
criteria.policyQuote: Symptoms persist for at least six weeks despite initial conservative management.
criteria.next: Run the Microsoft Foundry evidence review to compare the supplied clinical records with this criterion.

criteria.title: Conservative treatment documented
criteria.description: Treatment course, dates, and response must be included.
criteria.policyQuote: The record must document at least six weeks of provider-directed conservative treatment and response.
criteria.next: Run the Microsoft Foundry evidence review to compare the supplied clinical records with this criterion.

criteria.title: MRI order and indication are consistent
criteria.description: The requested study must match the documented indication.
criteria.policyQuote: The order must identify the requested MRI study and the documented clinical indication.
criteria.next: Run the Microsoft Foundry evidence review to compare the supplied clinical records with this criterion.

criteria.title: Red-flag exception
criteria.description: Urgent red-flag criteria are evaluated separately.
criteria.policyQuote: Red-flag findings may bypass conservative-treatment duration requirements.
criteria.next: Run the Microsoft Foundry evidence review to compare the supplied clinical records with this criterion.
